entities.summary: Wunibald Kamm was an automobile designer, engineer, and aerodynamicist. He is best known for his breakthrough in reducing car turbulence at high speeds; the style of car bodywork based on his research has come to be known as a Kammback or a Kamm-tail (Kamm-Heck). In addition, in German, the circle of forces is usually connected with his name.
